messages:
sam_partner_mgr: quick idea  'staggered rebate anchoring' for private offers. instead of one big rebate we split it into anchored milestones tied to commit stability + appliance share. aim: reduce OEM risk, smooth our liability, and keep SIs motivated. thoughts?

maya_sales: field likes predictable payouts. can anchors be calendar-aligned (monthly) or event-aligned (post-go-live)?

sam_partner_mgr: both. pilot supports event anchors (go-live + 60d + 120d) and optional calendar anchors. anchors only release OEM rebate after verification; customer discounts apply immediately via credits.

tony_finance: finance wants amortized recognition and a cap per contract. propose cap = min(3x monthly_commit, $20k). also need reserve calculations for pending anchors.

li_hw: OEM note: we won't pay on grant. we need appliance telemetry + invoice tie-out. prefer monthly visibility CSV and quarterly payout after audit. also want a small pre-announce for field so OEMs can plan.

nora_ops: ops: billing needs fields: anchor_reserved_usd, anchor_release_date, appliance_share_pct, verification_id. estimate 8 business days to add fields + 4 days QA. also require dispute flag flow.

jen_legal: legal: will draft anchor clause templates: definition of anchors, expiry, non-transfer, and clawback if churn within 45 days of anchor release. define verification process for appliance share.

maya_sales: sellers also want a short one-liner they can use: "Discount kicks in now; OEM rebate settles after verification at milestone dates." keeps it simple.

sam_partner_mgr: pilot plan: 8-week pilot, 4 private offers (2 SI-centric, 2 OEM-bundles). anchors: [go-live, +60d, +120d]. metrics: MoM revenue variance, anchor release delta, OEM reconciliation hours, dispute count.

tony_finance: prefer monthly micro-release of customer credits (to smooth P&L) even if OEM payout is quarterly. also request a clawback reserve for 45 days post-anchor release.

ci_bot: docs branch updated, preview link: https://docs-preview.redwood/anchors (CI passed).

sam_partner_mgr: copyable pilot config for eng/docs: 
```
staggered_anchor_config:
  anchors: [0, 60, 120]                     # days after go-live
  customer_credit_mode: "monthly_amortized"
  anchor_cap_formula: "min(monthly_commit*3,20000)"
  appliance_share_threshold: 0.50
  verification_evidence: ["appliance_csv","telemetry_sample"]
  dispute_window_days: 45
  rebate_payout: "quarterly_after_audit"
```

sam_partner_mgr: next actions:
- maya_sales: recruit pilot partners (ETA 5d)
- nora_ops: scope billing changes + ETAs (ETA 8bd)
- tony_finance: finalize cap & reserve rules (ETA 3d)
- li_hw: OEM CSV spec & visibility cadence (ETA 7d)
- jen_legal: draft anchor clauses (ETA 4d)

sam_partner_mgr: thanks all  we'll reconvene after scoping responses. :white_check_mark:
